Storage._README: Pluggable blob backend. Provider = 'Azure' (legacy Azure Blob) or 'Minio' (self-hosted on the VM; single bucket + container-as-prefix). On the VM set via env: Storage__Provider=Minio, Storage__PublicBaseUrl=http://<vm-ip>:9000, Storage__Minio__Bucket=<bucket>, Storage__Minio__AccessKey=..., Storage__Minio__SecretKey=... (secrets via env/.env only, never committed). PublicBaseUrl is the storage host clients reach — used to mint presigned upload URLs AND to allowlist the proxy-asset origin.

ReferralLinks._README: Doctor-portal links. TtlDays = how long a NEW link works (7-365). Links already issued keep the expiry they were signed with. A link a centre sent from the Doctor Links tab is renewed automatically RenewBeforeDays before it expires, over the same channel to the same portal (AutoRenewEnabled is the master switch; revoking a doctor's links turns their renewal off). A doctor holding an expired link can also request a fresh one, sent only to the contact on file - SelfServeCooldownHours is the minimum gap between sends to one doctor. PortalBaseUrl is only a fallback origin for a doctor whose link was never sent from the app; it is never taken from a request.
